children: Sabre priced an upsized $1,350,000,000 offering of 9.875% senior secured notes due 2032 and announced related tender offers.
Sabre Financial issued $1.35B of 9.875% senior secured notes due Oct 15, 2032; offering expected to close Sept 28, 2026.
Notes are secured by first-priority interests in substantially all assets of Sabre Financial and Sabre Financing, with foreign guarantees limited to $400M.
Gross proceeds will fund a new intercompany loan to Sabre GLBL to prepay existing intercompany debt and enable debt repayments/repurchases.
Sabre Financial launched a tender offer and consent solicitation for its 11.125% secured notes due 2029.
Sabre GLBL announced tender offers for certain 2029–2030 secured notes, with a maximum purchase price tied to the upsize ($250M cap).
